title: SEDI Age-and-Portrait Presentation
description: A holder-issued SEDI presentation for the common 'prove over-21 and show the state-endorsed photo' verification pattern (e.g. venue/alcohol admittance, Utah Code 63A-20-204(2)(a)). Issuer = the holder (Discloser); issuee = the verifier (Disclosee). It combines the holder's two source credentials by reference via I2I edges -- the SEDI Core identity credential (for the state-endorsed portrait, disclosed by selective disclosure of just that block) and a sedi-age attestation (for the over-21 boolean) -- and binds the verifier to the SEDI governance framework referenced in 'r'. It is issued into the holder's presentation registry, which 'rd' names (this.i @lm37js6k), so its state is anchored and revocable by the holder. This is the first concrete verifier-pattern schema; a general presentation-base would be extracted once a second pattern exists (this.i @sdp3wk).
$comment: An ACDC v2 attribute+edges+rules field-map credential (ilk 'acm'). The schema ENFORCES the pattern's teeth: every edge operator is pinned to const 'I2I' (the same-holder binding), and the governance reference 'r' and the presentation registry 'rd' are required, so an unregistered or non-I2I presentation is rejected. Migrated to the v2 envelope by this.i @lkfnoess, so the I2I edges into SEDI Core and sedi-age no longer cross a protocol-version boundary; 'rd' became required under @lm37js6k.
